title: FLA byte-oracles missing: fixtures/flash8-empty.fla is a 0-byte placeholder (never had content in git) and square-canon.fla is referenced but absent — 3 writer byte-gates permanently skip
description: fixtures/flash8-empty.fla is 0 bytes; git history proves the blob was EMPTY from its first commit (3062115 'add flash8-empty.fla', blob size 0), so the genuine WIN 8,0,0,478 empty doc (Contents 17312 B / Page 1 274 B) was never in the repo. Task 1207 added the hasValidFla8Fixture guard (packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/fla8-fixture.ts) so empty-bytematch.test.ts, carchive-validate.test.ts gate-1 and contents-structure.test.ts SKIP-with-reason — but that means the binary FLA writer's ONLY byte-level oracle (the keystone 'byte-perfect Contents' contract in CLAUDE.md and contents-write.ts) is permanently dark: the CONTENTS_POST_STAGE / CONTENTS_SCENE_TAIL / PAGE_FRAME_BODY templates in write/empty-templates.ts cannot be re-verified against ground truth. Separately, write/timeline-write.ts:437,488,509 claims the shape edge-stream encoder was 'verified against square-canon.fla' (exact type bytes 0xF3,0x30,0x30,0x30) but no such fixture exists anywhere in the repo — that verification is unreproducible and unguarded by any test. Why it matters: every byte-compat claim of the write path rests on these fixtures; without them regressions in the templates or the edge encoder are invisible. Fix: commit the genuine flash8-empty.fla (~17 KB OLE2, magic D0CF11E0A1B11AE1) and square-canon.fla binaries (requires a real Flash 8 oracle or the original author's copies — an agent must NOT fabricate them; ask the repo owner / recover from a machine that has real Flash 8). Acceptance: hasValidFla8Fixture returns true; pnpm --filter @flash/core test -- --run src/fla shows the 3 guarded gates RUNNING and passing (0 skipped for fixture reasons); add a byte-golden test for the edge encoder pinned to square-canon.fla behind the same guard pattern.
